profile.description: Active Snowbasin fall festival. In 2026 SnowWiesn runs Saturdays and Sundays Aug. 29-Oct. 18 with live music, food, market vendors and family-friendly activities.

notes.subject: Warm prior interest; 2026 event is active now
notes.body: Michael Rueckert replied in 2022 that Snowbasin would be happy to consider Adventure Zone in the future and asked about insurance, ticket pricing and revenue share. This was not a decline. Current official Snowbasin information confirms SnowWiesn is active in 2026 every weekend Aug. 29-Oct. 18 with family-friendly activities. Continue from the prior interest rather than sending a cold introduction.

followUps.label: Review 2026 SnowWiesn fit and availability
followUps.reason: The event is active through Oct. 18 and prior contact was receptive. Check route/package availability and whether Snowbasin still wants an outside family-entertainment area before following up.
